caption: The drawing depicts a single, large ceramic jug or crock with a metal lid and handle. The body of the jug is a light beige or gray color, featuring blue painted decorative floral designs on the front. The lid is metallic with a brown, weathered appearance, and includes a small round knob at the top center. The handle is made of metal and is attached to the neck of the jug on both sides, with a cylindrical wooden grip at the center. There is text written in black on the upper front of the jug, reading “COWDEN & WILCOX HARRISBURG.” The jug is placed against a plain, light tan background, with a subtle shadow cast below it. The artist’s signature, “J. Imantino,” appears in small, fine text at the bottom right corner.
title: Batter Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
